US8069128B2.description: A patent document titled "Real-time ad-hoc spam filtering of email" describing a multi-pass ad-hoc spam message filtering approach.

Multi-Pass Ad-Hoc Spam Message Filtering.entity_name: Multi-Pass Ad-Hoc Spam Message Filtering Approach
Multi-Pass Ad-Hoc Spam Message Filtering.description: A filtering approach that dynamically generates a temporary classifier during a first pass based on results of a previously applied message filter that sorts messages into folders, then uses the classifier in a second pass to retrospectively inspect messages.

First Message Filter.description: A previously applied message filter that sorts messages into a plurality of different message folders and stores first classification data in a persistent store.

Second Multi-Pass Message Filter.description: A filter configured to generate a classification model based on a first pass analysis, use it in a second pass to identify misclassified messages, and purge the model from non-persistent memory.

Classification Model.description: A model generated during the first pass analysis that resides exclusively in a non-persistent memory location and is used to score and identify misclassified messages.

First Classification Data.description: Classification data stored in a persistent store by the first message filter.

Second Classification Data.description: Classification data generated by the first pass of the multi-pass message filter, configured to reside exclusively in a non-persistent memory store.

Network Device.description: A device comprising a transceiver to send and receive data over a network and a processor operative to perform multi-pass message filtering actions.

Client Device.description: A user's device on which the classification model is maintained in memory and on which the first and second passes of the multi-pass message filter may execute entirely.

Processor Readable Storage Medium.description: A medium including data and instructions whose execution on a computing device provides for managing messages.

Message Folders.description: A plurality of different folders into which messages are sorted by the first message filter and inspected by the multi-pass message filter.

Misclassification Identification.description: An identification of sorted messages that might be misclassified, generated by the second pass and displayed so misclassified messages can be moved to different folders.

Non-Persistent Memory Location.description: A memory-resident-only location where the classification model resides, not stored on disk or another persistent data store.

Persistent Store.description: A persistent data store where the first message filter stores first classification data.

Message.description: An email message containing sender information, headers, subject, originating network address, contents, and attachments, sorted into folders and analyzed by the filters.

Address Book.description: An address book associated with a recipient that may be analyzed to determine whether a message sender's address is present when generating the classification model.
